Now, a little over a year into the reign of the health and human services secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr and NIH director Jay Bhattacharya, that guarded optimism has given way to despair. “A year and a half on, the dismantling of federal health research has proceeded at a more rapid pace and with greater destruction than in our worst nightmares,” says Gavin Yamey, director of the Centre for Policy Impact in Global Health at Duke University.
